name: AI JSON-LD Schema Generator
description: AI-generates schema.org JSON-LD for nodes and internal URLs and attaches it to the page head.
project_description: AI JSON-LD Schema Generator adds schema.org JSON-LD structured data to a Drupal site without hand-writing JSON. Using the Drupal AI module (any configured chat provider), it generates valid JSON-LD from a node's content or from any internal URL/path, lets editors preview, validate and edit the result, and attaches one or more <script type="application/ld+json"> blocks to the page head for the matching path. It supports per-content-type generation via a "Generate Schema via AI" button on the node edit form, URL/views-based schema mappings stored in a custom ai_schema_route entity, optional auto-generate on publish / regenerate on update, site-wide Organization and WebSite schema defined once in config, a configurable prompt template and token- or full-page content source, per-user Flood rate limiting, and a Google Rich Results Test preview link. Schema is stored by path in the ai_schema_route entity and rendered on every matching page view.
